_notes: Sheet 187 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-13. CardID = 18700 + idx; 403 = character card (sheet 4, 5x2, index 3). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [403, 18729]. Unlike the sheet-176 decks it has its own DeckID (187), so no other hero shares its CardIDs.

Every title, type, value, boost, copy count and text of the 12 titles was compared with unmatched-memory (John Henry was transcribed from screenshots, unverified) against the card images on 2026-11-13: no mismatch. Every card is restricted to JOHN HENRY (the deck has no sidekick). The nine copies of Nine-pound, Twelve-pound and Eighteen-pound Hammer carry the tag `hammer` (Bring Down The Mountain counts them in the discard pile with a `count_cards` Amount, not a HeroDef counter: a counter would need a dial in the bag); the card art does not print a HAMMER keyword, the tag is read from the titles (docs/heroes/john-henry.md, Pending Ivan).

Hero card (read from the image): JOHN HENRY, MELEE, START HEALTH 17, MOVE 2; STEEL-DRIVING MAN. The inner bag holds a Custom_Token_Stack of 10 track tokens (8ba84f), the miniature (041a3d), the life dial (887823, MAX_VALUE 17) and the deck (c3109e).
